requirements.description: Trente et Quarante deals two rows of cards on the shared exactly-once settlement core, Noir first then Rouge, each until its running pip total passes thirty so every row lands between thirty-one and forty. The row closer to thirty-one wins. A coup debits one bounded play-token stake and settles four even-money bets: Rouge and Noir on which row wins, and Couleur and Inverse on whether the first card's colour matches the winning row's colour. Any tie returns the whole stake as a push, except the refait at thirty-one where the bank bars half the stake; because the row and colour bets are otherwise symmetric, this refait is the entire house edge. Unknown bets and non-integer, non-positive, or over-limit stakes are rejected before any wallet movement.
requirements.notes: Allocated for GitHub issue #147, a catalog-expansion game (#73). The module supplies only pure rules; the shared core owns settlement.

requirements.description: Trente et Quarante inherits the shared core's exactly-once settlement: one caller-stable request id maps to one coup, a retry replays the identical committed rows and payout without moving the wallet again, and a request id reused with different wager content fails closed. The additive v1 contract exposes only the game-owned state and coups routes and never alters the frozen shared API. Both dealt rows always total between thirty-one and forty, and the published bet catalog reports honest bets and win, push, and refait multipliers.
